summary: Brown archaeology paper (Rigby 2016): reviews long ramp, spiral ramp, and Houdin internal ramp models; no conclusive evidence for any; internal ramp theory unproven.
content: Approximately two million stone blocks averaging 2.5 tons. Scholars propose ramps beside pyramids; prominent models are long ramp and spiral ramp. Jean-Pierre Houdin proposed internal spiral ramp. Long ramp would need to be over one mile long at 8-12 degree slope. Spiral ramp obscures corners. Houdin internal ramp: external ramp for bottom third, internal ramp ~6ft wide, 7% grade for top two-thirds; external ramp blocks recycled. Microgravimetry survey showed lower density edges. Still unable to conclusively determine ramp model; internal ramp theory unproven.
